ReviewedPolicyInput = Readonly<{reviewVersion:string; sourceUrl:string; sourceCapture:string; sourceCaptureSha256:string; capturedAt:number; expiresAt:number; configCanonicalJson:string}> — canonical JSON string of ReviewedQuotePolicyConfig; config hash recomputed and compared

PreparedMediaQuoteDraft = Readonly<{kind:'unknown'; mediaQuote:ProductionQuote}> | Readonly<{kind:'bound'; mediaQuote:ProductionQuote; budgetQuote:BudgetQuote; binding:QuoteAccountBinding; accountEvidence:AccountEvidence; accountArtifact:ProofArtifact; policyArtifact:ProofArtifact; quoteArtifact:ProofArtifact; quoteProof:QuoteProofLink; expectedGeneration:ProviderCredentialGeneration; capability:CapabilityReceipt}>
schemas: proof-policy.ts exports ReviewedQuotePolicyConfigSchema = z.strictObject per types above with bounds: TTLs int safe 1..3_600_000; estimates nonneg safe ints, estimateMin<=estimateMax; (unit==='minor_currency')===(currency!==null); currency /^[A-Z]{3}$/; entitlement/billingMode pairing (subscription<->subscription, tokens<->spark) validated at use; duplicate modelId entries reject; empty priceByModel allowed (all quotes stay unknown — fail closed, no invented prices). parseReviewedQuotePolicy(input:unknown):ReviewedPolicyInput validates ProviderReviewedPolicyPayloadSchema shape offline (hash integrity of sourceCapture and configCanonicalJson), providerId must equal observed provider at use time; anything missing/malformed => BUDGET_BLOCKED, never a default value. Default producer = {producerId:'budget-composer', producerVersion:'budget-composer-v1', sourceHash:hashCanonicalJson({schemaVersion:1,producerId:'budget-composer',producerVersion:'budget-composer-v1',sogni:readInstalledSogniProofMetadata()})}; injected producer permitted for fixtures only.
takeSeam: TakeServiceOptions gains commitPreparedQuote?: (tx:ProductionWritePort, draft:PreparedMediaQuoteDraft, context:Readonly<{recipe:ValidatedMediaRecipe;request:ProviderQuoteRequest;at:number}>)=>void. quoteRecipe signature changes to (input)=>Promise<PreparedMediaQuoteDraft> (sole existing caller is takes.test.ts:211, owned here; no production wiring exists yet). Behavior: no quoteRecipe => today's unknown quote, byte-for-byte; quoteRecipe returns kind:'unknown' => validate draft.mediaQuote exactly as today (quoteFor checks unchanged) and insert media quote only; kind:'bound' => same validation of draft.mediaQuote PLUS zod-parse budgetQuote/binding/accountEvidence/artifacts/link, then in the existing store.transaction AFTER the unchanged exact-context recheck: tx.insertQuote(mediaQuote), then commitPreparedQuote hook; hook throw rolls back everything including the media quote. bound draft with no commitPreparedQuote configured => BUDGET_BLOCKED before any write. selectTake/enqueue/preparation code paths must remain byte-equivalent except the seam types.
composerProtocol: prepareMediaQuoteDraft: strict-shape re-parse of recipe/request (fail BUDGET_BLOCKED). reviewedPolicy null OR no priceByModel entry covering (modelId, operation) => return {kind:'unknown', mediaQuote: makeUnknownQuote-equivalent with inputHash=hashCanonicalJson(quoteProjection(recipe)), entitlement:'unknown', null estimates/currency, withinAuthorizedCap:'unknown', expiresAt=now+30_000} — identical to the takes default so behavior is unchanged.

Bound path: await provider.observeAccount() (fake transport in tests); require observation.providerId===recipe.providerId, captured.accountId non-null. Sample at=now AFTER observation. Generation: head=store.read.getProviderCredentialGeneration(providerId); if head exists and accountId+credentialFingerprint match the observation => reuse head unchanged; else compareAndSetProviderCredentialGeneration({revision:(head?.revision??0)+1, generationId:`sogni-generation:${randomUUID()}`, accountId, credentialFingerprint, changedAt:at}, head?.revision??null); CAS false => re-read head once, adopt only if it now matches account+fingerprint, else BUDGET_BLOCKED (concurrent rotation). A->B->A never resurrects an old generationId.

account_session artifact (quote/web role): payload {schemaVersion:1,kind:'account_session',producer,generation,session:observation.captured.session,subscription:observation.subscription,observedAt:observation.observedAt,expiresAt:observation.observedAt+policy.config.accountSessionTtlMs}; artifact={schemaVersion:1,hash:hashCanonicalJson(payload),canonicalPayload:canonicalJson(payload),createdAt:max(observedAt,generation.changedAt)}. AccountEvidence={schemaVersion:1,id:`account-evidence:${idFactory()}`,providerId,accountId,source:`${producer.producerId}/${producer.producerVersion}`.slice(0,200),reference:`sha256:${accountArtifact.hash}`,observedAt:observation.observedAt,expiresAt:accountPayload.expiresAt,credentialBindingId:generation.generationId} (exactly the equalities sqlite.ts:139 enforces).
reviewed_policy artifact built verbatim from ReviewedPolicyInput via ProviderReviewedPolicyPayloadSchema; content-addressed re-insert is a no-op.

capability: await provider.discoverCapabilities(recipe.modelId) (fake in tests). Require provenance==='live_catalog', expiresAt!==null && > now, supports operation and required roles via existing canSatisfy; else BUDGET_BLOCKED (actionable, no unknown fallback).

mediaQuote: id=`quote:${idFactory()}`, inputHash=hashCanonicalJson(quoteProjection(recipe)) (must equal request projection hash — cross-checked by takes.quoteFor), entitlement=priceEntry.entitlement, estimates/currency from entry when unit==='minor_currency' else null/null, createdAt=now, expiresAt=min(createdAt+config.quoteTtlMs, accountArtifact.expiresAt, policyArtifact.expiresAt, capability.expiresAt) and must be strictly > createdAt else BUDGET_BLOCKED. withinAuthorizedCap computed advisory-only: 'unknown' when no current policy/authorization heads or caps null; 'yes'/'no' via existing summarizeBudget liability sums + checkedAdd against current heads read at commit time; admission re-checks independently.

budgetQuote (id `budget-quote:${idFactory()}`, expiresAt===mediaQuote.expiresAt, mediaQuoteId===mediaQuote.id, unit/currency/estimates from entry) and binding (id `quote-binding:${idFactory()}`, executionSemanticHash===recipe.resultTarget.inputsHash, credentialBindingId===generation.generationId, quotedAt===createdAt). Build the media_quote payload with canonicalRecipeJson=canonicalJson(recipe), canonicalQuoteProjectionJson=canonicalJson(quoteProjection(recipe)), executionSemanticHash=recipe.resultTarget.inputsHash, session=observation.captured.session, then FULLY ProviderMediaQuotePayloadSchema.parse it before returning the draft — no partial drafts escape.

commitPreparedQuote(tx,draft,{at}): insert order: insertProofArtifact(accountArtifact), insertProofArtifact(policyArtifact), insertAccountEvidence, insertBudgetQuote(budgetQuote,binding), insertProofArtifact(quoteArtifact), insertQuoteProof(quoteProof). Then recompute the advisory withinAuthorizedCap from current tx heads; if it differs from draft.mediaQuote.withinAuthorizedCap throw STALE_REVISION (atomic rollback). No network/FS inside the hook.
resolveBillingMode: exact modelId lookup in billingModeByMap; missing => BUDGET_BLOCKED. Never infer from family name or entitlement.

resolveAccountIdentity: fresh observeAccount + generation adoption as above, then insertAccountEvidence for this observation (content-addressed artifacts idempotent) and return {providerId,accountId,accountEvidenceId,credentialBindingId:generationId}. currentCredentialBindingId: durable head generationId iff provider.currentSession() exists and its accountId+credentialFingerprint match the head, else null (B3 then blocks).

prepareExecutionEvidence (B3 hook, async, outside tx): observeAccount (worker role), adopt/reuse generation, build+insert worker account_session artifact {same generation, session.role==='worker', expiresAt:observedAt+config.executionSessionTtlMs}; return the five TrustedPreparedExecutionEvidence fields with accountEvidenceId = the QUOTE-time evidence id resolved via getBudgetQuoteForMediaQuote(job quote)->quoteProof->payload.accountEvidence.id (validateExecutionProof requires this identity), expectedQuoteInputHash=budgetQuote.inputHash, executionSemanticHash=execution.executionSemanticHash, credentialBindingId=generationId.

prepareWorkerBudgetContext(job,quote,capability): reject unless job.operation is anchor|take, snapshot parses, resultTarget.inputsHash present; budgetQuote=getBudgetQuoteForMediaQuote(quote.id) and its quoteProof exist (else BUDGET_BLOCKED); execution={kind:'media_job',executionId:job.id,operation:job.operation,projectId:job.projectId,idempotencyKey:job.idempotencyKey,requestHash:job.requestHash,executionSemanticHash:snapshot.resultTarget.inputsHash,providerId:job.providerId,modelId:job.modelId}; call an internal createProductionBudgetService instance prepareBudgetContext (the 8-field result), attach providerProofDraft {workerArtifact,generation,observedAt,capability}.

reserveSubmission(tx,currentJob,quote,capability,now,context): zod-parse context as PreparedSubmissionContext; STRIP to exactly the eight B3 fields (budget.ts:330 strictObject rejects extras); call B3 createProductionBudgetService({store,resolveAccountIdentity,prepareExecutionEvidence,currentCredentialBindingId}).reserveInTransaction(tx, executionFrom(currentJob,snapshot), now, stripped); then build execution_session payload {producer, execution, mediaQuoteId, budgetQuoteId, quoteBindingId, accountEvidenceId, quoteProofHash, accountProofHash:workerArtifact.hash, generation, session:workerArtifact.session, capability, observedAt, expiresAt:min(workerArtifact.expiresAt, quoteArtifact.payload.expiresAt, budgetQuote.expiresAt, capability.expiresAt) strictly > observedAt else BUDGET_BLOCKED}; insert artifact + ExecutionProofLink {executionId:job.id,reservationId:reservation.id,artifactHash} in the SAME transaction (validateExecutionProof re-reads the reservation inside the tx).

submissionProofResolver(snapshot,captured,at) — SYNCHRONOUS, returns literal boolean, catches every internal throw => false: (1) ProviderRequestSnapshotSchema.safeParse ok; (2) job=store.read.getJob(snapshot.jobId) exists, status==='submitting', requestHash===hashCanonicalJson(snapshot), quoteId/modelId match; (3) link=store.read.getExecutionProof(snapshot.jobId) exists; artifact+payload parse, kind==='execution_session'; (4) payload.execution.executionId===snapshot.jobId && requestHash===job.requestHash && executionSemanticHash===snapshot.resultTarget?.inputsHash; (5) canonicalJson(captured.session)===canonicalJson(payload.session) && captured.credentialFingerprint===payload.generation.credentialFingerprint && captured.accountId===payload.generation.accountId; (6) head=store.read.getProviderCredentialGeneration(snapshot.providerId) exists and canonicalJson(head)===canonicalJson(payload.generation) (rotation denies); (7) at>=payload.observedAt && at<payload.expiresAt && at<payload.capability.expiresAt; (8) quoteProof=store.read.getQuoteProof(payload.budgetQuoteId) exists, artifactHash===payload.quoteProofHash, its payload.mediaQuote.id===job.quoteId; budgetQuote=store.read.getBudgetQuote(payload.budgetQuoteId), budgetQuote.mediaQuoteId===job.quoteId && at<budgetQuote.expiresAt; (9) reservation=getReservationByExecution(snapshot.jobId), reservation.budgetQuoteId===payload.budgetQuoteId. All nine pass => true; anything missing/unknown/mismatched/expired => false (fail closed, never throw).

Deviation from the 'SDK client exposes projects only' finding (now false): composer consumes P's observeAccount()/currentSession() facts; no new provider surface is created.

Deviation: prior PreparedSubmissionContext flowed opaquely into B3; budget.ts:330 strictObject rejects extra keys, so reserveSubmission MUST strip to the eight B3 fields before calling reserveInTransaction.

Prior unresolved root decisions now frozen here: TTL bounds (1..3_600_000ms per kind, quote TTL default 30s), advisory withinAuthorizedCap recompute-and-match at commit, producer identity derivation, execution expiry min-chain.
Worker-role account_session artifact is separate from the quote-time web-role artifact (required by sqlite.ts:157 workerPayload.session.role==='worker'); both share the durable generation.
C is fully offline-testable: provider is injected; every fixture observation/capability is schema-valid fake data; no env key, no network, no paid call.
